title: מוס

steps: להוסיף החלמונים ל-1 ואחרי שמתקרר להוסיף הכל לקצף

notes: Group 1 (chocolate, coffee, cognac, powdered sugar) and group 2 (cream, sugar) are each marked with a curly bracket and a word written to its left: group 1's word reads 'להמס' (to melt; partly covered by a stain) and group 2's is 'להקציף' (to whip).
A triangle/arrow mark is drawn at the end of the last line (an end mark; no text).
A scribbled/crossed-out mark stands just before the powdered-sugar quantity; the quantity itself reads 1/2 (also read as 1/2 by Gemini).
The egg numeral '6' is written over an earlier mark (bold overwrite); Gemini also reads 6, and the card's later steps are consistent with whites and yolks being separated.
Gemini's 'מיכל קצפת צמחית (ריץ')' and its elaborated method (small pot, bain-marie, folding, serving cups, refrigerating) are not on the card and were not copied.
Source set by the owner (issue #357): דונה / אילנה.
incidental_text: A mark resembling '8' in the top-right corner of the note (meaning unclear; possibly a sorting mark).

uncertainties.reason: The unit is a single compressed glyph; readings differ and the ink does not decide between them.
The small connecting glyph between 2 and 3 looks like a lone 'א'-like mark, not a clean letter; the meaning 'mix 2 with/and 3' is clear from context.
